en.askTitle: Put in your own area, space and budget and get the same home-versus-gym comparison
en.runTitle: Denver: a $300 home setup against a gym membership, starting in January 2027

fields.label: Budget
fields.value: About USD 300 for a home setup

fields.label: Clear floor space and ceiling height
fields.placeholder: e.g. 2 m × 2 m of clear floor, 2.4 m ceiling

fields.label: Current equipment and experience
fields.placeholder: e.g. no equipment, never lifted weights before

fields.label: Weekly schedule
fields.value: Strength training three times a week

en.template: Help me choose home training or a gym in {area}, starting {date}, with {budget}, {space}, {equipment}, {health} and {schedule}. Compare delivered equipment costs with written membership terms, flag stock gaps, suggest safe substitutions and show when I may need more load. Make a plan only; do not purchase or enrol.

phases.title: Check gym fees, equipment prices and exercise guidance in public sources
phases.note: Three Denver-area gyms, a priced home kit, CDC and ACSM guidance
phases.judgment: The gym researcher corrected a price before it spread: the city’s official page lists $30.75 a month, not $34, and the $332.10 annual option is an alternative way to pay, not an extra fee. Fees a gym does not publish were left as “not published” rather than turned into $0, and the kit researcher withdrew an earlier Target price it could not trace back to the page.

phases.title: Write the guide and the dated source notes
phases.note: Cost comparison, 12-week beginner programme, decision guide
phases.judgment: The limits are stated up front instead of buried: the $248.97 dumbbell set needs to come back in stock, the alternative kettlebell is backordered, and January prices are not guaranteed.

phases.title: Run one final check of the page display and content

workers: Found the published monthly, annual and joining fees of real gym memberships in the Denver area
Found current retailer listings for a home kit under $300: adjustable dumbbells, a mat and resistance bands

chipNames.https://www.denvergov.org/Government/Age: City of Denver: recreation centre memberships
chipNames.https://www.cdc.gov/physical-activity-ba: CDC: physical activity guidelines for adults

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的地区、场地和预算，得到同样的居家训练与健身房对比
zh.runTitle: 丹佛：300 美元居家器材对比健身房会员，2027 年 1 月开始

fields.label: 可用净空和层高
fields.placeholder: 例如：可用地面约 2 米 × 2 米，层高 2.4 米

fields.label: 现有器材和训练经验
fields.placeholder: 例如：没有器材，之前没练过力量

zh.template: 请帮我比较在{area}居家训练还是去健身房，计划{date}开始，预算{budget}，可用净空和层高{space}，现有器材和训练经验{equipment}，健康或活动限制{health}，每周安排{schedule}。比较器材送达总价和书面会员条款，提醒缺货问题、合适的动作替代，以及何时可能需要更大负重。只做计划，不购买、不办理会员。

phases.title: 用公开资料核对健身房费用、器材价格和训练指南
phases.note: 丹佛一带三家健身房、带价格的居家器材、CDC 与 ACSM 指南
phases.judgment: 查健身房的同事在错误扩散前改了一个价格：市政府官方页面写的是每月 30.75 美元，不是 34 美元，而 332.10 美元的年付只是另一种付款方式，不是额外费用。健身房没公布的费用写成“未公布”，没有记成 0 美元；查器材的同事也撤回了一个无法追溯到页面的 Target 价格。

phases.title: 撰写指南和带日期的来源笔记
phases.note: 费用对比、12 周新手训练计划、选择建议
phases.judgment: 限制写在显眼处，没有藏起来：248.97 美元的哑铃套装需要等补货，备选的壶铃目前缺货，1 月的价格也不保证不变。

phases.title: 最后检查一遍页面显示和内容

workers: 查丹佛一带真实健身房会员的公开月费、年费和入会费
查 300 美元以内的居家器材套装在零售商处的当前标价：可调哑铃、瑜伽垫和弹力带
